decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the Certificate of Lawfulness is GRANTED.

The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 12th June 2001, the use of one room of the residential property for the operation of a chauffeur business ancillary to the property's use as a single-family dwellinghouse is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The chauffeur business involves only one room of the house which operates as a telephone contact point with no other internal or external alterations to the property. The scale and nature of the business use is ancillary to the residential use with the property continuing to function as a dwellinghouse. There is no material change of use of part or whole of the dwelling and therefore planning permission is not required. 

Informative:	
Please be informed that it is a highway offence for vehicles to cross a public footpath without a formal vehicle crossover.  Further advice can be obtained from the Council Highways Maintenance (Consultancy) on Tel. 020 8583 4913.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed use of one room of the residential property for the operation of a chauffeur business ancillary to the property's use as a single-family dwellinghouse.
